title: Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i: A 180 Hz IPS Monitor on a Budget
summary: The Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i is a 23.8-inch 1080p Fast IPS monitor with a 180 Hz refresh rate, 1 ms GTG response, FreeSync and 99% sRGB. Here's what Xiaomi lists, the trade-offs and who it suits.
description:
## Who is it for?

- Competitive FPS players on a budget.
- Anyone upgrading from 60/75 Hz.
- Clean, minimal desk setups.

## Why consider it?

- 180 Hz Fast IPS, 1 ms GTG (Xiaomi).
- FreeSync and 99% sRGB.
- Factory calibration (ΔE < 2, per Xiaomi).

sections.title: What is the Xiaomi G24i?
sections.content: The G24i is Xiaomi's budget esports monitor, sold globally as model P24FCA-RGGL and in Europe under the ELA5625EU code. Xiaomi lists a 23.8-inch Fast IPS panel at 1080p with up to 180 Hz and 1 ms grey-to-grey response.

sections.title: Gaming performance
sections.content: 180 Hz is a step above the common 144–165 Hz class, and FreeSync reduces tearing with compatible GPUs. Xiaomi notes that its 1 ms GTG figure comes from its internal lab; we haven't measured it. To use 180 Hz, connect via DisplayPort and make sure your PC can push high frame rates.

sections.title: Picture quality
sections.content: Xiaomi lists 250 nits, 1000:1 contrast, 99% sRGB and individual factory calibration with ΔE below 2. That is good for a budget monitor, though 250 nits is modest in bright rooms. Xiaomi mentions an HDR display enhancement, but there's no HDR certification — treat it as a picture mode, not real HDR.

sections.title: Design, stand and ports
sections.content: The body is slim with narrow bezels and a joystick for the menu. The stand only tilts (5° forward, 15° back); for height adjustment you'll need a VESA 75 arm or bracket, which isn't included. Ports are DisplayPort 1.4, HDMI 2.0 and an audio output. There are no speakers, and power comes from an external adapter.

sections.title: Who should buy it — and who shouldn't
sections.content: Buy it for a fast, inexpensive 180 Hz 1080p monitor with good out-of-box color. Skip it if you need speakers, height adjustment, USB-C, high brightness or a sharper 1440p panel.

sections.title: Sources for this review
sections.content: Zero Technology has not used this monitor in person. This is a research roundup based on Xiaomi's global product overview and specifications pages, checked November 2026. Images are official Xiaomi product images from mi.com/global.

pros: Slim, minimal design with joystick control.
Strong refresh rate for the price.
cons: External power adapter; VESA bracket not included.

faq.question: Is the Xiaomi G24i good for Valorant and CS2?
faq.answer: Yes. 180 Hz and FreeSync make it well suited to fast shooters.

faq.question: What's the difference between ELA5625EU and P24FCA-RGGL?
faq.answer: They are regional codes for the same G24i: ELA5625EU is the EU product code; P24FCA-RGGL is the model on Xiaomi's global spec page.

faq.question: Does it have speakers?
faq.answer: No. Use the audio output for headphones or external speakers.

faq.question: Can I wall-mount it?
faq.answer: Yes, it supports VESA 75 × 75 mm, but the bracket isn't included.

faq.question: Which cable for 180 Hz?
faq.answer: Use DisplayPort 1.4 for the full 180 Hz at 1080p.

faq.question: G24i or ASUS VG249QE5A?
faq.answer: Pick the Xiaomi for 180 Hz; the ASUS for wider color gamut and built-in speakers.
